args.message: March IT services recharge (47,000.80 USD) posted in 1000 today as JE-1000-001245 (Dr 1300 partner 2000 / Cr 4900, ref ICR-0326). I did not post the 2000 side manually: 1000->2000 has auto-mirror on, and the intercompany mirror job JOB-0104 runs tonight at 22:00 and will create the 6900/2300 entry in 2000 dated today, same as Jan and Feb (JE-2000-000869/000870). A manual 2000 posting would have doubled it. Please check the mirror entry tomorrow morning.
